title: UFO Endless Runner — Tactile Low-poly Variations

frames.name: rubber-squeeze-toys
frames.title: Rubber squeeze toys
frames.prompt:
ART DIRECTION: ridiculous squeaky rubber bath-toy invasion. Entire Earth cast consists of low-poly soft-touch rubber toys with oversized rounded bellies, little molded seams and only tiny flat facets, no photorealism. Cows shaped like swollen pears with tiny heads and giant nostrils, sheep squat foam puffs, pigs short fat beans, farmer hats huge flexible rubber discs. UFO is a small glossy coral squeeze-toy saucer with three oversize mint bulbs; abducted cow shows a simple comic squash-and-stretch pose as if gently squeezed. Tank is stubby dark teal rubber with a disproportionately big soft barrel, jeep has oversized squashy tires. Quiet BUTTER-YELLOW ground, dusty peach path, cobalt shrub lumps, coral roof planes. Strong colour blocking, gentle contact shadows, almost no surface noise. HUD and upgrade chips use thick soft rubber shapes. Sweet, tactile, mischievous; absolutely no standard olive realistic tank or generic green grass.
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create ONE portrait 9:16 style frame for a real buildable mobile UFO-abduction endless runner. It is an overhead gameplay screenshot, not a poster, splash art, physical product photo, or moodboard. A flat playable Earth ground plane fills the screen; camera points down from high above, no sky, horizon, low-angle diorama or side-scrolling view. All game objects are small, with clear paths and lots of navigable space ahead. Use simple reusable LOW-POLY 3D models, exaggerated funny silhouettes, distinctive tactile materials, limited materials and modular scenery. The craft must be visible but realistic to implement with simple meshes and stylized shaders. No voxel construction or embroidered felt.
GAME: a small UFO near the lower-middle occupies about 10 percent of screen width. It travels upward over a sparsely furnished farm landscape. Abduction reads as a transparent mint circular radius footprint on the ground, two curved dotted suction trails and small targets lifting upward. One ridiculously shaped cow is tumbling upside down, one small farmer flails with a hat drifting away. Additional tiny cows, sheep, pigs and people ahead are collectible targets. A small military tank at top edge and jeep at left threaten the UFO, with one clearly indicated red missile intercepted by a thin laser. All vehicles and targets are viewed from overhead and remain game-sized. No side-view tractor-beam cone, giant hero characters, realistic warfare, injuries or gore. A couple of roof-view farm structures, a path, fence sections and simple tree crowns frame quiet terrain, not dense decoration.

frames.name: carved-wood-folk-toys
frames.title: Carved wooden folk toys
frames.prompt:

Cream maple cows with geometric black painted patches, top-heavy peg farmers with huge mustard wood hats and tiny wooden boots, scalloped carved sheep, dusty red wooden pigs. UFO is a smooth petrol-blue turned-wood disc with brass pin lights, attached comically wonky laser barrel. Miniature military toys are dark indigo-painted wood with wooden wheels and dowel barrels. Open PALE SAGE terrain resembles a matte painted flat wooden play board, broad cream path, rust roof triangles viewed from overhead, dark pine-green carved tree tops. Small-team feasible textures and simple geometry, warm even lighting, no photographic craftsmanship clutter. HUD feels like little painted wood tiles with stamped numerals; upgrade tiles use carved icon shapes. Farmer spins stiffly like a peg while hat separates, cow rotates like a tumbling carved toy. Distinct spare geometric landscape.

frames.title: Glazed ceramic oddballs
frames.prompt:

Small UFO is a shiny deep cobalt ceramic saucer with peach dome and turquoise glaze rim, like an eccentric teacup lid. Mint capture radius has very thin simple game effect; cow spins belly-up, hat flies off. UI uses small off-white glazed tiles with cobalt lettering and simple stamped icons. No photorealism or physically cluttered pottery display.

frames.name: folded-paper-sculptures
frames.title: Folded-paper sculptures
frames.prompt:
ART DIRECTION: sculptural low-poly origami arcade, real-time 3D forms that look folded from matte dyed cardstock, sharply creased planes and restrained paper-fiber shader. This is a simple polygonal game world, not a photographed paper diorama. ALL forms are triangular wedges and folded broad planes. Cows are absurd wide triangular paper bellies balanced on four narrow folded legs, oversized tiny folded ears; sheep folded cream fans, pigs coral angular concertinas; farmers are tiny trapezoid bodies with giant cone hats. UFO is a small folded hexagonal turquoise dish with one off-center origami dome. Tank is a dark navy folded accordion with an enormous rolled-paper barrel; jeep chunky zigzag wheel folds. PALE SKY-BLUE ground plane with ochre broad paths, sparse geometric white tree crowns, vermilion roof shapes. Hard geometric silhouettes and crisp short shadows, minimal soft edges. A folded cow tumbles like a paper airplane and the farmer's cone hat sails away. HUD on narrow cut-card strips with clean navy typography; three simple folded-tab upgrade chips. Direct overhead roofs only, no visible sky, fresh triangular-field map layout, lots of quiet blue ground.

frames.title: Retro space-age toys
frames.prompt:
ART DIRECTION: funny 1960s space-age tin-and-enamel toy design, simple low-poly meshes with bold tapered silhouettes, clean cream enamel, candy-orange accents, restrained polished chrome and a little ribbed rubber. Cow and farmer spin upward like wind-up toys with hat off; dotted mint suction, orange threats. UI cream enamel plaques with thin orange inset lines and simple retro rounded numerals. Different map: road runs along upper-right perimeter and small buildings cropped lower-left.

frames.name: scrap-tin-carnival
frames.title: Scrappy tin carnival
frames.prompt:
ART DIRECTION: witty recycled tin-toy world translated into efficient low-poly 3D. Angular bent sheet-metal silhouettes, broad rusty red and turquoise paint panels, a few big visible rivets, dull exposed steel edges, tiny restrained paint scratches. Avoid busy kitbash detail. Cows look like battered white enamel kettles with little black spot panels, tiny funnel snouts, four bolt legs and big bent-metal ears; sheep crimped cream tin clouds, pigs rusty-pink oil-can beans. Farmers are simple little tin peg silhouettes with absurd pan-lid hats. UFO is a small dented turquoise saucepan-lid saucer, mismatched lemon and orange bulbs and one crooked riveted laser nozzle. Tank is a stubby dark rust-blue tin box with an enormous short funnel cannon, jeep boxy folded tin with bottle-cap-like simplified wheels. Quiet DUSTY ROSE ground, warm cream paths, charcoal-blue folded tree crowns, small mustard roof planes; no scrap heaps or garbage clutter. A cow spins belly-up showing its hollow toy construction; farmer floats like a rattly toy with pan hat adrift. HUD stamped turquoise tin plates with white lettering, compact riveted icon chips. Strong overhead game camera and generous clear center space.

frames.name: blacklight-miniatures
frames.title: Blacklight miniatures
frames.prompt:
ART DIRECTION: hyper-graphic low-poly blacklight miniature arcade. NOT a neon wireframe game: all models are solid chunky flat-shaded 3D meshes with broad angular facets and matte fluorescent painted surfaces. Nearly black INKY NAVY ground, saturated violet shadow geometry, sparse cyan short tree crowns, hot orange roof silhouettes, luminous LIME UFO with a pink-black dome. Simple readable black-white cow models with oversize luminous pink ears, squat cyan-cream sheep, bright pink bean pigs, tiny angular farmers with huge orange hat discs and cream boots. Military tank and jeep are compact solid vermilion toys, short chunky barrels and black wheels. Use a single simple soft fill and painted emissive accents, restrained bloom only on player and threats, no detailed realistic lighting. Humour is crisp silhouette and exaggerated proportions; upside-down abducted cow has four tiny fluorescent boots in air, hat drifts off farmer. Radius thin mint/cyan disc against quiet dark blue. HUD hot-pink/cyan sparse graphic panels, plain legible white numerals, three small black-plastic upgrade chips. Almost no ground texture, only a few wide violet crop shapes. Looks like a distinct practical mobile real-time low-poly game, not futuristic cityscape or illustration.
